name: Paul Precious
headline: Senior Director: EMEA Business Transformation Oracle
about:
I am a highly motivated Business Transformation Senior Director with over twenty five years of experience; including spending the last fifteen years within Management consultancy, advising my clients how to optimise and transform their organisations based on adopting best practice process and ways of working. This includes developing the Global Process Model for Oracle consulting, underpinned by an innovative end to end business process model that enables a shift towards Process Led consulting, allowing a more customer centric delivery method whilst assuring programme outcomes and reducing time to value.

Before that, I qualified as a Management Accountant and spent over ten years working with number of commercial finance functions across a variety of sectors including Management Consultancy, Telecommunications, Aerospace and Defence, Automotive, Pharmaceutical and Retail. 

Throughout my working career, I have demonstrated the ability to work under pressure both as a team player and as an individual and I am comfortable working in a fast paced, dynamic environment. An effective communicator, I have demonstrated the ability to influence, negotiate, present, lead and delegate to achieve success. I offer considerable drive, energy, enthusiasm and commitment and take pride in achieving my goals.
… more

experiences.description:
•	Responsibility for sale and delivery of several large Business transformation projects as well as improvements to the Global Consulting Operating model, including:
o	Designed and implemented the new FY26 EMEA Oracle Consulting organization, aligning to the prevailing Corporate vision and strategy and establishing a central Delivery Centre of Excellence for approximately 800 functional consultants.
o	Developed an extensible Business process model for Global Oracle Consulting based on industry best practice and built from the foundations of standard Oracle product development processes.
o	Created the Metro Map, a visualization tool that depicts an end-to-end customer business process in the context of standard oracle cloud functionality, driving a significant shift towards process led consulting.
o	Drafted the foundations of the new consulting delivery method with a focus on being more solution advisory and customer centric.
Helping to drive continuous improvement for our clients by adoption of modern best practice in their transformation journeys, enabled by Oracle Cloud applications.

•	Responsibility for delivery of several large Business transformation projects, including:
o	Oracle Cloud implementation for UK ‘Big-4’ UK Supermarket, working with software vendor to harmonise and align approach.
o	Led reporting rationalisation project for a UK multinational alcoholic beverage organisation.
o	Defined a reporting Centre of Excellence for a global corporate soft drinks organisation.

experiences.position: Senior Management Consultant - Enterprise Performance Management
experiences.description:
As an EPM Consultant at Capgemini I am responsible for assisting clients by using macro-business processes to plan and deliver sustainable improvements to their organisation. Typically these improvements give the client focus and direction by aligning their resources to the most important factors, such as what drives profitability and setting the right targets. Examples of projects I have worked on are as follows:

Led a project at a Fortune 500 Global Pharmaceutical company to improve core processes surrounding inventory control. Based on the improvement actions identified I then scoped and managed an additional project to implement a reporting framework to validate and rationalise European inventory levels and associated reserves in line with USGAAP

Created the balanced Corporate scorecard for a ‘Big-4’ UK supermarket to be used in the monthly board meeting, including supporting KPI’s with detailed definitions and a clear ‘line of sight’ linking operational activities to strategic corporate objectives

Devised a Corporate dashboard and reporting toolset for a global Oil & Gas company to measure the delivery status and performance of each IT project, including variances to budget and forecast and commentaries of any issues affecting portfolio performance

Business planning and reporting process re-engineering project for a multi-national wholesaler, recommending improvement opportunities in line with best practice

Full responsibility for all opex costs associated with Banking, Credit and Collections, Billing and Bad Debt for all brands within the Talktalk business (circa. £50m opex per annum). The provision of decision support services included month end cost reporting, budgeting, forecasting and gaining external audit approval

Analysis of debtors and payment patterns by customer and product to understand the month on month change required to the bad debt provision, with the results used to determine strategic direction on sales channel optimisation and credit scoring

Ad hoc project work such as derivation and implementation of operational cost reduction processes by analysing KPI’s and identifying risks and opportunities that need to be addressed, leading to bottom line profit improvements with the support of the operational management team

As the Head of Commercial Finance I managed a team of 4 people and was the finance business partner, being directly responsible for all pricing decisions. My objective was to increase group turnover whilst also improving existing margins. This required working at board level with the MD and FD as well as with senior sales managers and the purchasing department, where I often had to drive supplier negotiations. Other aspects of this role included:

Successful preparation of several fixed price tenders, all at significantly better margins that existing clients (Macdonald Hotels, Centra Stores and Gala Bingo)

Preparation of budgeting and forecasting for all sales by consulting with the sales managers to understand when specific stock roll outs would occur to ensure no major variances in the weekly sales analysis versus budget

Ownership of all commercial reporting including weekly internal KPI reporting and discharging contractual reporting obligations to customers as part of the required managed service. Typically this included analysis of sales, prices and stock and required a high level of understanding of the bespoke financial reporting systems

As the Financial Controller I had full responsibility for the P&L, balance sheet and cash flow, as well as internal and statutory financial reporting and all budgeting and forecasting, using estimates to complete to understand the profitability of fixed price contracts. During my time at Magellan I was responsible for the following:

Re-calculating the required charge rates and developing a change in the operating model, moving to larger Fixed Price contracts. This enabled the organisation to turn a £0.5m loss into a £1.2m EBITDA profit within 18 months

Creation and presentation of a bid template that calculated complex business cases. This included amortisation of design costs and recovery through the manufacturing of required volumes of aeroplanes, assessing the payback through IRR and NPV summaries. As the number of prospective aeroplanes could fluctuate depending upon the source of information used I had to ensure that a prudent approach was undertaken to justify the value of the asset to the auditors at each year end, including foreign currency adjustments. I then presented this template to the groups Owner as part of the Airbus A350 bid, which he subsequently approved

As part of the BOWMAN Project Finance team I was required to offer full commercial support to the relevant Deputy Program managers, including production of the monthly financial project status and quarterly Estimates to complete by liaising with the project planners. As BOWMAN was a £2bn fixed price contract it was essential that all specific work packages could be measured, identified and controlled to ensure there was no project cost over-run. During this role I designed a new month end procedure that reduced the month end close by 2 days

In addition to this responsibility I was also recruited to be the group expert for Earned Value, requiring preparation of a detailed report analysing the Schedule and Cost variances to the project baseline and present this to the customer to highlight any slippages. Based on this information the customer would make an informed decision on whether or not to pay the relevant project milestone revenue

CD Car Profit Planning

Responsible for all in-cycle programs including different vehicle derivatives and current Mondeo freshening. Through liaison with the different project teams I created feasibility studies based upon NPV and IRR calculations to determine which projects would be undertaken based upon the boards expectation of profitability

Monthly and quarterly preparation of detailed forecasts versus budget for the consolidated vehicle line. This was done by co-ordinating with the respective vehicle line function to assess any changes to the current assumptions. Total vehicle line profitability was then presented to the European vehicle line controller in preparation for the publishing of the corporate CBG profitability

Developed a new profit model to help ensure the new platform Mondeo and Galaxy vehicles received financial approval at the strategic Intent program gateway

B Car Launch Team

Provision of full financial support to the vehicle launch team, including calculating the financial impacts of any engineering changes required to the vehicle. This was undertaken in a high paced environment as any delays to the production line would be costly and compromise program timing

Responsibility for the variable cost tracking of all electrical, powertrain and chassis components to the vehicle. This required working with cross functional teams to understand risks and opportunities and also negotiating with suppliers to ensure costs were in line with program expectations, including introduction of supplier owned tooling initiatives

International Export Operations
Direct liaison with the markets to ensure that any claims they submitted for incorrectly shipped goods were correct and refunded or recharged in a timely manner. Whilst in this role I Identified a major error with engineering changes and re-engineered the process to save over $1m, equal to 10% of forecast annual profit
